artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body portrait of a young boy standing next to an ornately designed chair. He is facing the camera directly, with one hand resting on the back of the chair. The boy has a round face with youthful features and short, tightly curled hair. He is wearing a buttoned jacket over a shirt, and trousers. The photograph is bordered by a decorative frame with elaborate floral motifs in black and a gold-colored inner border. The background shows a simple patterned floor.

artworks.title: "Remember Me, Annie"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman in a half-body portrait within an ornate gold-colored border. She is sitting upright with her hands in lace gloves in front of her. The woman has a composed expression, short hair, and wears a dark dress with lace details. The background is plain, emphasizing the details of her attire and the frame. No jewelry is visible.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an individual seated in an upright position. The person's head is turned slightly towards the camera, with a calm expression. The face is round with soft features, and the hair is short and close-cropped. The person is dressed in a dark coat with a clerical-style collar and a black bow tie, holding a closed book. The image is encased in an ornate frame with gold floral designs. The background is a simple, plain backdrop.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman and Boy
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image displays a woman and a child positioned side by side. The woman is seated, wearing a full-skirted dress with stripes, a belt, and long sleeves. Her hair is styled back, and she has a calm expression. The child stands to her left, wearing a light-colored outfit and a hat. They seem to be resting one arm on a small table or chair. The image is framed with floral and patterned designs. The background is plain with a carpeted floor visible.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Baby
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a young child shown from the torso up. The child is seated and appears to be supported in an upright position. The child's facial features are soft and youthful, with a round face characterized by large, expressive eyes, a small nose, and lips, and the hair is short and closely cropped. The child is dressed in a light-colored garment, possibly a gown or dress, which covers their torso down to an unseen waist. The outfit features a high collar and the fabric appears to be light. The child is placed against a darker backdrop, possibly a fabric drape or chair, which contrasts with the child's attire. The image is framed in an ornate, oval-shaped gold frame that features intricate designs and detailing, enhancing the overall presentation of the photograph. The background is intentionally neutral and unobtrusive.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Girls with Dolls
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows two young girls seated closely together. The girl on the left is turned slightly towards the right and looks at the camera, while the girl on the right faces forward, also looking at the camera. Both girls have their hair styled into neat, slicked-back buns. The girl on the left wears a patterned off-the-shoulder dress with short sleeves and appears to be holding a small item in her hands. The girl on the right wears a light-colored, off-the-shoulder dress with decorative trimming. An intricate patterned cloth or blanket is draped over their laps, and each holds a doll—one on the left has a doll wrapped, possibly in a quilt, while the one on the right holds a doll dressed in a light dress. The background is plain and unobtrusive, and the image is framed with an ornate, gold-colored decorative border.

artworks.title: James Collins Johnson, Princeton University
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated from the chest up with a serious expression. He has short, neatly groomed hair and is wearing a formal suit with a vest, inner shirt, and bow tie. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain, and the photograph is framed with an oval matte. Below the image is a handwritten signature, "James C. Johnson."

artworks.title: Severn Teackle Wallace
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing in a relaxed posture. He has short, light-colored hair and is wearing a dark suit with a light-colored vest, white shirt, and dark bow tie. One hand is on his hip, and the other holds a cane. He is looking slightly to the side in front of a decorative chair with a wide-brimmed hat on it. The background is plain, and the floor is covered with a patterned carpet.

artworks.title: "The Cathedral, Baltimore, Maryland"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an urban street from an eye-level perspective. Buildings line the street, with a street lamp in the center and a man standing by the curb. A large building with a brick facade is on the right, while trees line the street, adding a touch of greenery. The color palette is dominated by soft, muted sepia tones, typical of early photography.

artworks.title: Eliza "Didy" Ridgely and Possibly Charlotte Gittings
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: Two women in full-length profile standing side by side. The woman on the left is wearing a long layered dress with a cape adorned with dark trim, a small hat and styled hair. The woman on the right is wearing a striped dress with a shawl and a bonnet tied under her chin, holding a garment or coat over her arm. The background includes a plain draped curtain and a scenic backdrop on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman with a Wash Tub
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a woman kneeling next to a wooden washbasin with a washboard inside. She is facing the camera, with dark eyes and short, close-cropped hair. She is wearing a striped dress with long sleeves and a light-colored apron. The woman appears to be holding the washboard with one hand, suggesting she is washing clothes. The background is plain and unadorned, likely in a studio setting with a simple backdrop.

artworks.title: James Hopkinson's Plantation, Edisto Island, South Carolina
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows several individuals around a wooden cart pulled by a donkey. A man sits at the front of the cart holding the reins, another man sits inside the cart, and a woman stands holding a shovel, leaning against the cart's wheel. Beside the donkey, a woman holds a young child. In the background, three people stand near a white wooden building in a rural setting with sandy ground, large trees, and hanging mosses.

artworks.title: Jack Brunner
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy standing upright with his right hand in his pocket and left hand holding a cap. He has short, curly hair and a neutral facial expression. The boy is dressed in a formal suit with a bow tie. The background features a simple studio setting with a curtain with tassels on the left side. The overall image has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Alice
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright with her body slightly turned to the side and her head facing forward. She has a neutral expression and her hair is pulled back. She is wearing a dark-colored, long-sleeved dress with a high neckline, white collar, and buttons down the front. Her left hand rests on an upholstered piece of furniture with fringed detailing. The background is plain with a small trim along the lower perimeter.

artworks.title: Frederick Douglass
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man seated in a chair. He is slightly turned to the side, with his left arm resting on the armrest of the chair. He has a prominent mustache, well-defined cheekbones, thick, voluminous, curly, graying hair, and is wearing a dark coat, a vest, a high-collared shirt, and a necktie or cravat. The background is plain, and the chair has patterned fabric.

artworks.title: Sojourner Truth
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman in a half-body portrait. She is positioned sideways but turns her head to face the camera. Her facial features are strong and pronounced, with high cheekbones and a determined expression. She wears a clean white bonnet on her head. Her clothing consists of a dark dress with a white shawl draped over her shoulders. The shawl has a lace fringe. The woman is holding some knitting or crochet work in her hands, with a ball of yarn on her lap. Next to her is a small table covered with a patterned cloth, upon which are a vase of flowers and what appears to be a few books. The background is plain and textured. The bottom of the image bears the caption "I Sell the Shadow to Support the Substance," followed by the name "Sojourner Truth."

artworks.title: "Young Africa"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a young child's upper body and head. The child is seated, facing the camera. They have short, curly hair and expressive facial features. The child is wearing a plaid-patterned piece of clothing. The background is plain and neutral, with no discernible objects or scenery. The image is presented within a styled border with text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Lewis Charlton
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man from the waist up, standing with his right hand resting on a carved surface. He has short, light-colored hair and a full beard. He is dressed in a dark long coat with a high collar and buttons down the front, wearing a white shirt underneath. The coat has a flower on the left side of his chest, and a medal below it. The background is plain and neutral. A yellow mat borders the photograph with a text label at the bottom that reads: "Lewis Charlton, 50 years in bondage in Maryland, U.S.A. & for 28 years suffered the worst effects of Slavery."

artworks.title: Wilson Chinn
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This appears to be a tan-colored photograph showing a man standing upright, his body facing slightly to his left and his head turned to look at us. His skin tone is unclear due to the tan color of the photo. His hair is short and dark, and he has a graying beard. He is wearing a jacket with large buttons down the front, trousers, and shoes. He appears to have an iron collar around his neck that has three long points sticking up. There are chains around his ankles, and a long rod attached to his left leg. On the floor next to him are other objects including a paddle, a thick ring, and a long object that is only partially visible. The floor he stands on and the wall behind him are plain. Below the photograph are several lines of text.

artworks.title: "Bell Boys at the Barrett House, Burlington, Iowa"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts two seated men from head to feet. On the left, a man holds two instruments and seems to be in mid-action, while the man on the right holds a tambourine in a playing posture. Both men have short, dark hair, wear hats, and have discernible facial features with a calm expression. The man on the left wears a light-colored suit with a vest and shirt underneath, while the man on the right wears a dark jacket with a shirt, both with long pants and shoes. The background shows patterns on the floor and a simple wall.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and Dog
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image features a man sitting on a chair, turned slightly to the right, with a calm expression. He has a smooth complexion, short hair, and wears a dark hat. The man is dressed in a dark suit jacket, light-colored shirt with a high collar and tie, and light checkered pants. He is holding a long-haired dog gently in his left hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Abraham
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man in black and white, seated from the waist up. He faces slightly to the left, with legs apart, and rests his right hand on his right knee. The man has short, tightly curled hair and a neutral expression, looking directly at the camera. He wears a long-sleeved shirt, buttoned at the neck, and trousers. A belt is visible around his waist. His left hand grips the edge of his shirt or trousers. There is no visible jewelry. The background is plain, with no discernible objects, providing a simple contrast to the subject. The photograph is bordered by a red line against a slightly discolored backdrop.

artworks.title: William Headley
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This sepia-toned photograph shows a young Black man standing upright, with his feet together and his hands clasped in front of him. He looks out at us with a neutral expression. The top of his head is covered by a hat with an uneven rim, and his clothes are covered in rips and tears. He wears a cloak with a frayed edge over one shoulder, and underneath it is a light shirt or jacket with several holes. His pants are similarly ripped and appear to be made of two different kinds of fabric. His shoes are worn. The wall behind him is light and slightly textured, and the floor has a faint checkered pattern.

artworks.title: Captain Horace James
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man captured from the shoulders upward. He is positioned facing forward directly at the camera. His facial features include a serious expression with a thick and full beard and mustache. He has a prominent forehead and wears round spectacles. His hair is short and combed back, with a slight wave. He is dressed in a dark, buttoned suit or jacket. The background is plain and light-colored, with some faded or aged spots and a thin border around the photograph.
